highlights.title: Custom Tokens in Customize Preview
highlights.description: Customize Preview now includes Custom Tokens, allowing the theme to be adjusted freely in the preview by editing the core color tokens directly.

highlights.title: Carousel primitive refactor
highlights.description: Carousel primitives were refactored around a more flexible composition model, with clearer controls, pagination dots, thumbnails, drag-free behavior, and updated docs examples.

highlights.title: Modal and sheet exit motion
highlights.description: Modal and sheet overlays now keep their panel and backdrop mounted long enough for the leave animation to run instead of disappearing immediately when closed.

highlights.title: Switch default surface polish
highlights.description: Switch now uses the border token for its unchecked surface, giving the control a quieter default state that fits better with the rest of the 1.0 theme.

sections.title: Added
items: Customize Preview now includes Custom Tokens, allowing the theme to be adjusted freely in the preview by editing the core color tokens directly.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed modal close behavior so the panel and backdrop can play their leave animations before the dialog is disposed.
Fixed sheet close behavior so side-aware exit animations run for right, left, top, and bottom sheets.
Kept reduced-motion preferences respected for modal and sheet close transitions.

sections.title: Changed
items: Refactored Carousel primitives around a more flexible composition model, including clearer controls, pagination dots, thumbnails, drag-free behavior, and updated docs examples.
Adjusted the default switch background and hover tokens to use the border color instead of the input color.
Cleaned up obsolete foundation token references.
